hni_signals: PRACTICE OWNERSHIP AND BRAND-BUILDING - the standout signal on this row. He runs his own personally branded vascular centre, CWC Vascular Care ('Cure Without Cut' Vascular Care), with its own domain (cwcvascularcare.in), its own clinic-domain email on his own name, its own appointment system, and a large content-marketed website of service and condition pages. His own site markets it as 'one of the most advanced and best vascular & endovascular center of Hyderabad & Telangana'. SENIORITY: publicly titled Senior Consultant Vascular and Endovascular Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals Hitec City. MULTI-LOCATION PRACTICE: consults at Yashoda Hitec City (mornings, Mon-Sat 09:00-17:00) and at Kukatpally (evenings, Mon-Sat 17:30-20:30), with a prior Yashoda Secunderabad attachment - a genuine two-session-a-day, multi-site private practice pattern. PREMIUM SPECIALTY: aortic and endovascular surgery, angioplasty and stenting, varicose vein laser/RF ablation and dialysis AV access - high-margin, device-intensive, largely elective and cash-pay work. ACADEMIC POST: former Assistant Professor of General Surgery, PDU Medical College, Rajkot. PUBLICATIONS AND CONFERENCE PRESENCE: his own site states he has published research papers on vascular surgery; profile material additionally references research presented at the Society for Vascular Surgery Annual Meeting and the Charing Cross Symposium with publications in the European Journal of Vascular and Endovascular Surgery and the Journal of Vascular Surgery - a human should confirm the last point, see notes. MEDIA / THOUGHT LEADERSHIP: authored a bylined national press article, 'India's Quiet Vascular Crisis: Thousands Die Each Year From an Aneurysm They Never Knew They Had', syndicated on ANI News and webindia123 in May 2026, publicly calling for national aneurysm screening. ACTIVE PROFESSIONAL SOCIAL MEDIA: he personally posts clinical/educational content on LinkedIn, X and Facebook under his own name. Trained at Narayana Hrudayalaya, Bangalore, one of India's leading cardiovascular centres.
